posts.name: ASHUTOSH kumar
posts.cooked: I am new to this course how should i study this for better understanding and good score too . Calling experienced and passed students to share experience.

posts.name: S.Vignesh
posts.cooked:
Apart from the usual advice of practice, I would suggest going through the course accompanying book “Navigating Linux” by the course instructor Sayan.

Lectures alone will not be sufficient. It is good for a very basic introduction to the topics. For more depth you can find the lecture topics in the book.

posts.name: Sonu kumar
posts.cooked: that book has 562 pages, so it is impossible to read the whole book. So if I want to read some topics, then how would I know in what depth I have to study

posts.name: S.Vignesh
posts.cooked:
You don’t have to read the entire book in one sitting. You could find the topics of the week and find the appropriate sections in the book. This way you will have several weeks to go through the book.

The level of depth depends on you. The practice assignments, graded assignments, ppas, grpas, BPTs will give you some idea on the level. So, you can prepare accordingly.

posts.name: Achuthan M
posts.cooked: Subscribe the youtube channel , start watching the top rated videos, solve small questions on your own first to grasp understanding. revise key areas for OPPE. Iteratively revise GA, PAs . Reading the book as per requirement is better. Also a same question can have multiple solutions.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: The best thing you can do is go through the lectures, refer to the book for the topics you want to gain deeper understanding and practice. Nothing is better than practising. The more you practice the better you get.
